notes.title: Dev Log of July 25th, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is Nocturn.[/p][p]Time has flown by, and it’s already time to share the July development update.[/p][p]First, I’d like to apologize — last month, my physical and mental health were not in the best condition, so the pace of development has been slower than before.[/p][p][/p][p]1. Haize's Route Progress[/p][p]Including the prequel, a total of 14 chapters have been completed, and the script for the next chapter is already finished.[/p][p]To express progress in percentages: Scenario 60%, Art 60%, and Coding 55%. [/p][p][/p][p]2. Translation Work[/p][p]As mentioned previously, the translation process will begin once I’ve finished writing the entire route—including the ending—in my native language.[/p][p]That said, since I’m personally handling the English translation, I’ll do my best to complete it as quickly and with as much quality as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]3. Other Notes[/p][p]If you’d like to receive updates sooner than these monthly reports (posted on the 25th), feel free to follow me on Twitter (X).[/p][p]>[url="https://x.com/tmnoc_official "]https://x.com/tmnoc_official [/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you always for your support.[/p][p]Wishing you all a wonderful day! [/p]

notes.title: The Kickstarter pre-launch page is now live!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176498/593914731f37851b6b420f18ff9e1dccb30d158c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]This is Nocturn, and I recently opened the Kickstarter pre-launch page.[/p][p]After the launch of <Eternal Glory> I’ve received interest and support from many people, which I’m truly grateful for.[/p][p]However, despite that, the development costs have far exceeded what I can personally cover, and I’ve inevitably decided to run a Kickstarter campaign.[/p][p]The entire funding goal will be used solely for the game's development—covering things like voice acting, voice editing, OST production, and marketing—with almost none allocated as personal income.[/p][p]I sincerely want to complete this project to the best of my ability, and to do that, I truly need the support of otome fans.[/p][p]I’m preparing the rewards to be as generous as possible, so I would be deeply grateful if you could follow the Kickstarter pre-launch page and continue to show your interest.[/p][p]If you'd like quicker and more frequent updates, please check out my Twitter account as well.[/p][p]Thank you always for your support![/p][p][/p][p]▶Kickstarter: [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nocturn/romance-of-cruel-fate-fantasy-otome-game-eternal-glory"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nocturn/romance-of-cruel-fate-fantasy-otome-game-eternal-glory[/url][/p][p][/p][p]▶Twitter: [/p][p][url="https://x.com/tmnoc_official"]https://x.com/tmnoc_official[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dev Log of June 25th, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is Nocturn.[/p][p]Time has flown by—it's already June, and half the year has passed.[/p][p]I hope you’ve had peaceful and joyful days during that time. Let me share the current development status of Eternal Glory as of June.[/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]1. Haize Route Progress[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176498/5c5d8c16e34156fd92b7bd56a93fc01cace7b22e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i][b][u]Chapter 10 and the prequel section of the scenario, artwork, and coding are now complete.[/u][/b][/i][/p][p]To give you a rough breakdown: scenario is at 45%, art at 50%, and coding at 45%.[/p][p]With the experience gained from working on Uria’s route, and my desire to provide an even better gameplay experience for the other routes, I’ve been preparing a greater variety of assets. I sincerely hope you’ll look forward to it![/p][p](That said, since 4 CGs for Haize have already been revealed, I plan to avoid releasing any more to preserve the in-game experience.)[/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]2. Translation Plans[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]English and Japanese translations will begin only after I finish writing the full route, including the ending, in my native language.[/p][p]This decision was made to ensure the highest quality of translation, so I kindly ask for your understanding.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Regarding Updates[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]As mentioned previously, I've already updated the game to improve the Japanese translation and added an option to toggle screen shake effects on/off.[/p][p]I continue to welcome feedback, and based on user input, I may release another update before Haize’s route is officially added.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Future Plans[/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p]To be honest, development funds are running very low—even excluding my own labor costs.[/p][p]However, thanks to the amazing support from many players, and my own determination to complete Eternal Glory to the best of my ability, I’ve reached a point where I must make some difficult decisions.[/p][p]Although it’s not finalized, I’m seriously considering launching a Kickstarter campaign to fund voice acting and audio production, etc.[/p][p]I’m working hard to plan a schedule and rewards that will be satisfying for everyone, so I hope you’ll take interest in the campaign when it goes live![/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]5. Other Notes[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176498/352d048dea7f0438a6e643161c0e0f5759d9ed2e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once the Kickstarter begins, I’ll be able to provide a clearer roadmap, but for now, my goal is to release Haize’s route within this year.[/p][p]Your support and encouragement mean everything to me as a solo developer working on this project alone.[/p][p]Thank you once again for playing Eternal Glory and cheering me on—I truly appreciate every one of you.[/p]

notes.title: Develog of May 25th, 2025.
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Nocturn.
First of all, thank you sincerely to everyone who has shown interest in <Eternal Glory> and taken the time to play it.

As <Eternal Glory> is currently in Early Access, I believe it would be good to provide regular updates on the development status. I plan to post updates on the 25th of every month going forward.

Now, here is the development status as of May:

[b]1. Based on player feedback from Uria’s route, I am planning one major update.[/b]

-Option to toggle screen shake ON/OFF
-Improvements to Japanese translation
-Other fixes and enhancements

[b]2. Work on Haize’s route is currently in progress.[/b]

-Coding and in-game asset implementation completed up to Chapter 4.
-Assuming around 30 CGs without variations, 20% of the CGs are complete.
-Scenario for Chapter 5 is complete.

[b]3. Since I occasionally receive questions and feedback, I will list my email address again below.[/b]

-indieteam.nocturn@gmail.com

Thank you.

notes.title: Eternal Glory Early Access Ver 1.0 Released!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Nocturn.
The Early Access version of <Eternal Glory> has finally been released!
You can now enjoy Uria's full route with full English voice acting.
Routes for Haize and Ismei will be open in the future.
I eagerly hope that you enjoy the game.
Always thank you for your support!

notes.title: Early Access Announcement(Dec 10, 2024)
notes.notes:
[b][Eternal Glory] - Early Access Announcement[/b]

Hello, everyone!
I'm here to announce <Eternal Glory> will be released in early access in March, 2025.

Originally, I was planning to release all of the routes.
However, since the volume is substantial, I had to decide early access release of Uria's route.

I hope your understanding, and please feel free to purchase and play the game!

***

[i]>Character: Uria Mahel
>About 20 Chapters
>About 80000 Words
>7 Hours Play Time
>About 15 Background Illustrations
>About 30 CGs.
